# hostd_vm (Resource)

A Public Cloud virtual machine. Creation waits until the VM is running; destroying hard-stops it first. CPU, RAM, disk, CPU class and networking can be changed in place (the API only allows lowering CPU or RAM on a stopped VM, 24 hours after create or the last increase). Import with `<project_id>/<vmid>`; `os_image`, `ssh_key_ids` and `username` are create-time inputs the API does not return. After an import, set `os_image` and `ssh_key_ids` in the configuration (they are recorded without replacing the VM) and omit `username`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "hostd_vm" "web" {
  project_id  = hostd_project.main.id
  hostname    = "web-01"
  os_image    = "debian-12-amd64.qcow2" # a name from data.hostd_os_images
  ssh_key_ids = [hostd_ssh_key.admin.id]
  cores       = 2
  ram_gb      = 4
  os_disk_gb  = 20
}

output "web_ipv4" {
  value = hostd_vm.web.ipv4
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cores` (Number) vCPU count (even numbers from 2), within the account CPU quotas.
- `hostname` (String) DNS-style hostname (letters, digits, hyphens and dots; at most 64 characters).
- `os_disk_gb` (Number) OS disk size in GiB, in steps of 20 GiB; between 10 and 100 GiB per vCPU. It cannot shrink.
- `os_image` (String) Image name available in the project, e.g. `debian-12-amd64.qcow2`. List the available names with the `hostd_os_images` data source.
- `project_id` (String) UUID of the project (`hostd_project`) the VM belongs to.
- `ram_gb` (Number) RAM in GiB; between 1 and 4 GiB per vCPU.
- `ssh_key_ids` (Set of Number) IDs of SSH keys (`hostd_ssh_key`) to install, from one to five. The VM is reached with these keys: the provider sets a random cloud-init password and does not expose it.

### Optional

- `cpu_mode` (String) CPU class: `light` or `regular` (default).
- `lan_vnets` (Set of String) Names (VNet) of private networks to attach; each gets a free address.
- `username` (String) Cloud-init username. Defaults to the OS image's default user.
- `wan_mode` (String) Public network: `off`, `ipv4`, `ipv6` or `dual` (default). With `off`, attach at least one private network. Switching between `ipv4`, `ipv6` and `dual` requires going through `off`.

### Read-Only

- `ipv4` (String) Public IPv4 address, empty when none is attached.
- `ipv6` (String) Public IPv6 address, empty when none is attached.
- `vmid` (Number) VM identifier (VMID) assigned by the API.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import hostd_vm.web 0b6e5f7c-4f4e-4a43-9c0e-6f4d3b2a1c90/104
```
